name: context-menu-38
description: A commit history list with copy SHA, checkout, cherry-pick, and revert actions.

files.content:
import { ArrowLeftRight as ArrowLeftRightIcon, Cherry as CherryIcon, Copy as CopyIcon, GitBranchPlus as GitBranchPlusIcon, GitCommitHorizontal as GitCommitHorizontalIcon, GitCompare as GitCompareIcon, Undo2 as Undo2Icon, } from "@designali/icons" import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/context-menu" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const commits = [ { sha: "a41f9c2", message: "Add 40 new pricing blocks", author: "AI", time: "2h", }, { sha: "7be03d1", message: "Fix dark mode tokens in templates", author: "AI", time: "5h", }, { sha: "c9921aa", message: "Bump @designali/icons to v2", author: "AI", time: "1d", }, { sha: "15e7f40", message: "Refactor landing page hero", author: "AI", time: "2d", }, ] export default function GitCommitHistoryMenu() { return (
{commits.map((commit, index) => (
{commit.message} {commit.author} · {commit.time} ago
{commit.sha} {commit.sha} Copy SHA Compare with working tree Create branch from commit Cherry-pick Checkout commit Revert commit ))}
) }
